==1995==
In April 1995, six Iranian Kurds were killed in attacks in Iraqi Kurdistan, reportedly carried out by Iranian government agents.<ref>{{cite web |title=Iranian Kurds 1943–Present |url=https://uca.edu/politicalscience/home/research-projects/dadm-project/middle-eastnorth-africapersian-gulf-region/irankurds-1943-present/ |publisher=University of Central Arkansas |access-date={{subst:date}} }}</ref> On June 5, two members of an Iranian Kurdish group were shot dead in Iraqi Kurdistan under similar circumstances, according to the U.S. State Department's yearly report on terrorism.<ref>{{cite web |title=Iranian Kurds 1943–Present |url=https://uca.edu/politicalscience/home/research-projects/dadm-project/middle-eastnorth-africapersian-gulf-region/irankurds-1943-present/ |publisher=University of Central Arkansas |access-date={{subst:date}} }}</ref>
On August 4, the Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan (KDPI) claimed that Iranian government agents assassinated its representative in Baghdad. Tehran denied the charges and suggested the killing resulted from internal disputes among opposition forces.<ref>{{cite web |title=Iranian Kurds 1943–Present |url=https://uca.edu/politicalscience/home/research-projects/dadm-project/middle-eastnorth-africapersian-gulf-region/irankurds-1943-present/ |publisher=University of Central Arkansas |access-date={{subst:date}} }}</ref>
In September and October, Iranian Kurdish opposition groups accused Iranian officials of torturing and executing ten Kurdish political prisoners affiliated with the KDPI. Around 345 people were also arrested during this period for similar alleged infractions.<ref>Reuters, October 3, 1995; Foundation for Democracy in Iran, October 20, 1995.</ref>

Military clashes resumed on December 4, 1995, when the KDPI reportedly killed 15 members of the Iranian security forces in western Iran.<ref>{{cite web |title=Iranian Kurds 1943–Present |url=https://uca.edu/politicalscience/home/research-projects/dadm-project/middle-eastnorth-africapersian-gulf-region/irankurds-1943-present/ |publisher=University of Central Arkansas |access-date={{subst:date}} }}</ref>
